prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A simple sack or bundle tied at the top with a single diagonal line for
the tie.
formatted_prompt: Flat app icon centered on an off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding. A single bold sack silhouette — rounded plump body tapering to a gathered neck — filled in warm burnt sienna (#D97742), with a compact flat knot shape at the top rendered in deep terracotta (#B04646). One diagonal flat bar across the neck in dark near-black (#0B0F14) reads as the tie. All edges crisp vector geometry, no gradients, no texture, no brushwork. Subject occupies roughly sixty percent of the canvas, centered, readable at 16px. Clean 2026-era UI icon register, flat bold fills, sharp silhouette.
